How to buy a server and create your own node

Your own node is a relay server on the internet. It helps your devices and your friends' devices find each other faster, and makes messages, files and calls more reliable — especially on networks that block things. The node CANNOT see your messages: everything is end-to-end encrypted.

1. BUY A SERVER (VPS)
• The cheapest VPS is enough: Ubuntu 22.04 or 24.04, 1 CPU, 512 MB–1 GB RAM, a public IPv4 address (usually $3–6/month).
• Buy it from any VPS hosting (e.g. Hetzner, DigitalOcean, Vultr, Aeza, Timeweb Cloud). Sign up, choose a VPS plan with Ubuntu, pay by card.
• You will receive the server IP, a login (usually root) and a password.
• Tip: if something is blocked where you live, pick a server in a country with stable connectivity, as close to you as possible.

2. CONNECT TO THE SERVER
• Windows: open PowerShell and run: ssh root@SERVER_IP (or use PuTTY).
• Android: install Termux, then: pkg install openssh and ssh root@SERVER_IP
• Enter the password (it is not shown while typing — that's normal).

3. INSTALL THE NODE (use "Copy commands" below and paste them into the server one by one)
• Install Docker:
curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sh
• A user for the node and a folder for its key (the key survives updates):
sudo useradd --home-dir /var/lib/tox-bootstrapd --create-home --system --shell /sbin/nologin --user-group tox-bootstrapd
sudo chmod 700 /var/lib/tox-bootstrapd
• Start the node (official image toxchat/bootstrap-node, ports 443, 3389 and 33445):
sudo docker run -d --name tox-bootstrapd --restart always --user "$(id -u tox-bootstrapd):$(id -g tox-bootstrapd)" -v /var/lib/tox-bootstrapd/:/var/lib/tox-bootstrapd/ --ulimit nofile=32768:32768 -p 443:443 -p 3389:3389 -p 33445:33445 -p 33445:33445/udp toxchat/bootstrap-node
• Open the ports (if the ufw firewall is enabled; also open them in the hosting panel firewall, if any):
sudo ufw allow 443/tcp; sudo ufw allow 3389/tcp; sudo ufw allow 33445/tcp; sudo ufw allow 33445/udp
• Port 443 must be free (no website on this server).

4. GET THE NODE KEY
sudo docker logs tox-bootstrapd 2>&1 | grep -i "public key"
You will see a 64-character string (digits and A–F) — the node's public key. Copy it.

5. ADD THE NODE TO THE APP
Settings → "My nodes" → "Add node":
• Name — anything (e.g. "My server");
• Address — the server IP;
• Port — 33445;
• TCP ports — 443, 3389, 33445;
• Key — the 64 characters from step 4.
Tap "Save", then "Check all" — you'll see 🟢 and the latency in ms. The node is used first right away, no restart needed.

6. SHARE WITH FRIENDS
Tap the node → "Share". When a friend opens the link, the app offers to add the node.

7. UPDATE (once a month)
sudo docker stop tox-bootstrapd && sudo docker rm tox-bootstrapd && sudo docker rmi toxchat/bootstrap-node
then run the start command from step 3 again. The key stays the same.

If the node is unreachable (🔴): check that the server is on, the ports are open in the hosting firewall and docker ps shows tox-bootstrapd.

The most reliable anti-DPI option is VLESS + Reality on your own server: IP, port, UUID, public key (pbk), shortId (sid) and a decoy domain in sni (e.g. www.microsoft.com). DPI sees ordinary HTTPS to that site.

Link format:
vless://UUID@IP:443?security=reality&sni=www.microsoft.com&pbk=KEY&sid=ID&fp=chrome&type=tcp&flow=xtls-rprx-vision

Paste it with «Paste». VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, WebSocket, gRPC, XHTTP are supported too.

Hi! I'm inviting you to S-messenger (StoykoMessenger) 👋

🛡 WHAT IT IS
A next-generation messenger with no servers. Messages, photos, videos, voice notes and calls go directly between phones (P2P, the Tox protocol) and are end-to-end encrypted - nobody can read them: not the carrier, not the provider, not even the developer.

👤 ANONYMITY
• No phone number, e-mail or sign-up - just a 76-character ID.
• No servers storing your chats: there's nothing to leak or hand over.
• Contacts and history live only on your phone; you can set a PIN and hide chats.

🚀 WHY IT'S BETTER
• Works through any blocking: any internet will do - mobile, Wi-Fi, with or without a VPN.
• Built-in VPN (VLESS, Reality, Trojan, Shadowsocks and more), DPI bypass without a server (ByeDPI), free Cloudflare WARP, your own network nodes.
• Groups and channels, stories, reactions, stickers, animated emoji, video notes, a video player, YouTube and Pinterest inside.
• Built-in AI assistant S-AI.

👨‍💻 Developer: Стойко Андрей (Andrey Stoyko). Open source (GPL-3.0).

📲 HOW TO ADD ME
1. Install the app from the attached APK (if the phone asks, allow installing from this source).
2. Open S-messenger and create a profile.
3. Tap ➕ “Add contact” and paste my ID (all 76 characters):

%1$s

4. Tap “Add” - I'll accept the request and we can chat!

Every message, photo, video, voice note and call is encrypted right on your phone and decrypted only on your contact's phone. Keys are created on the devices and never sent anywhere.
• Algorithms: Curve25519 (key exchange), XSalsa20 (encryption), Poly1305 (tamper protection) - the NaCl/libsodium library.
• Each session gets its own temporary keys: even if a key were ever stolen, past chats couldn't be opened with it.
• You can verify the channel really is encrypted in a chat: menu → “Encryption check”.

1. You type - your phone encrypts the message with your contact's key.
2. The Tox network (P2P) finds their phone: network nodes only help two devices find each other, like a directory.
3. The message goes directly between phones (UDP). If the direct path is closed, it goes through a TCP relay - but the relay sees only encrypted bytes.
4. Your contact's phone decrypts the message and replies with a “delivered” receipt.
Contact offline? The message waits on your phone and leaves by itself as soon as they're back.
Why the carrier and provider see nothing

Your carrier and provider see only encrypted packets - like noise. They can\'t see the text, photos, files, who you write to by name or your contacts. Decrypting the traffic without the keys from your phones is impossible.\nWith the built-in VPN, DPI bypass or WARP the provider can\'t even tell it\'s a messenger.

The messenger has no servers of its own: no database of accounts, numbers or chats. There\'s nothing to hack, leak or hand over on request. Your address is a 76-character ID created on your phone. History is stored only by you and your contact.\nThat\'s why the messenger works through any blocking - any internet will do.

The built-in VPN has four modes - exactly one, the selected one, works at a time:
• Servers - your own VPN server (VLESS/Reality, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, Hysteria2, WireGuard): traffic looks like ordinary HTTPS.
• DPI bypass (ByeDPI) - no server: the first packets are split and shuffled so the provider's equipment can't recognise them.
• Fragments - the Xray core splits the TLS hello and adds noise, no server.
• WARP - free Cloudflare WARP over AmneziaWG, obfuscated.
The big button at the top turns the selected mode on and off. The messenger itself works without servers - VPN is for websites and apps.

Beat the dealer without going over 21.

6-10 count face value, J, Q, K count 10, an ace counts 1 or 11. 36-card deck, 4 decks in the shoe.

Place chips and tap “Deal”. Hit takes a card, Stand stops, Double doubles the bet for exactly one card (on the first two cards), Split splits a pair into two hands (split aces get one card each).

The dealer draws below 17 and on soft 17. Over 21 is a bust.

A win pays 1 to 1, blackjack (ace + ten-value on the deal) pays 6 to 5, a push returns the bet. Bet 0 plays for free.

A message can be a tiny app: confetti, a player with an equalizer, slots, tic-tac-toe, a clock, a poll, a boarding pass, charts. To send one: type “/” in the empty message field - a list appears, tap the one you want (you can type the name too: /slots). Or hold Send → “🧩 HTML bubble” → “✨ Live messages” - there you can preview each one live before sending. Works in chats and groups, with no internet inside the bubble.

Hold a chat in the list - a preview with actions opens (read, pin, mute, archive). Tap a chat - the avatar and name fly into the header. Swipe from the left edge - back with a spring. New messages fly up from the input field. If animations get in the way - Settings → “Reduce motion” or lite mode.
